descriptionChirho: To explore or spy out a territory for military or settlement purposes, as in the reconnaissance of Canaan (Num 13–14) and similar scouting missions (Judg 18, Josh 2).
To explore or investigate a matter through wisdom and intellectual inquiry, used especially by Qoheleth for his philosophical examination of life (Eccl 1:13, 2:3, 7:25).
Participial substantive denoting traders or merchants who travel about for commerce, as in the revenue from 'the traders' (1 Kgs 10:15, 2 Chr 9:14).
In the Hifil stem, to have advantage or surpass in value, as wisdom excels folly (Eccl 2:13).
